structure.definition: Physical lines include blanks; function count includes private functions, methods, nested functions and special methods. Public callables exclude underscore-prefixed module functions and immediate methods. Tests excluded. Import connections are distinct project-module pairs, including deferred imports.
structure.explanation: Actual code retains ownership/history checks, explicit old-source comparison, cache integrity checks and numerical checkpoint validation. Definition reduction and repeated-work reduction take precedence over the line estimate.

tests.packaging: Editable material-scan 0.3.0 installed with --no-deps --no-build-isolation in a temporary virtual environment; console command check studies/reference-eight.yaml passed.

search.comparison: same feasible coordinates, common measured responses and SE, complete CMA populations

task_hashes.scope: task preparation only, seven trials; identical physical/build records

comparison.comparison: selected response with matched sites and realizations

realization_check.interpretation: Welch interval ignores pairing; a diagnostic check, not a strict independent-sample experiment when random streams are shared.

live_reference.interpretation: The full paired 95 percent Student-t interval is inside the predefined plus/minus 5 percent margin. This checks this reference and matched random streams. Sixteen sites do not establish spatial convergence. Single-run elapsed times are descriptive; no statistically measured total transport speedup is claimed. The final verification-only edits were also checked by exact rendered-input comparison and unchanged raw-data reanalysis.

physical_kernels.scope: isolated calculations, same G4CMP Python3.12 NumPy2.4.6, noGeant4

task_preparation.scope: task preparation only, seven trials; identical physical/build records

full_read_only_reanalysis.scope: complete read-only 128-task reanalysis, seven trials per implementation

time_array_storage.meaning: Calculated array-storage bound only; excludes decompression, time vectors, ODE arrays, metadata and other process memory.

efficiency.cached_regression: One scorer identity, one candidate rendering, one task-table fetch, one count-array preparation and one SHA per raw hit file in an unchanged cached invocation. No hit-file parsing or transport.

remaining_limits: Old rounded-key optimizer checkpoints are explicitly rejected; start a fresh search rather than infer ambiguous proposal identities.

Optional TPE, live Ollama, external material-catalog access and presentation export were not exercised with live services in this round.

The pooled nonlinear density response has no estimated pooled standard error; per-realization values are retained.
